When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

The 2011 Toyota Prius Three is a highly efficient and dependable hybrid hatchback that combines exceptional fuel economy, practical versatility, advanced technology, and the long-term reliability that has made the Prius one of the most successful hybrid vehicles ever built. Designed to minimize fuel costs without sacrificing comfort or usability, the Prius remains a smart choice for commuters, families, and drivers seeking an economical and environmentally conscious vehicle.

Powered by Toyotas proven Hybrid Synergy Drive system, the Prius combines a 1.8 liter four-cylinder engine with an electric motor to deliver smooth performance and outstanding fuel efficiency. The hybrid system seamlessly switches between gasoline and electric power to maximize economy while providing a quiet and comfortable driving experience. Known for its durability and low operating costs, the Prius has earned a reputation as one of the most dependable hybrids on the road.

The exterior styling of the 2011 Prius is aerodynamic, modern, and instantly recognizable. Its distinctive shape is designed to reduce drag and improve efficiency while providing excellent interior space. Clean body lines, a sleek profile, and functional design elements help the Prius achieve the fuel economy that made it famous.

Inside the cabin, the Prius Three offers a spacious and thoughtfully designed interior with seating for five passengers. High-quality materials, comfortable seating, and an innovative dashboard layout create a practical and user-friendly environment. The elevated hatchback design provides excellent visibility and a roomy feel for both front and rear passengers.

The Three trim adds desirable upgrades that enhance convenience and technology. Features include a touchscreen display, Bluetooth connectivity, USB integration, steering wheel mounted controls, keyless entry with push-button start, and an upgraded audio system. These features help create a more connected and enjoyable driving experience.

One of the Prius's greatest strengths is its practicality. The hatchback design and versatile cargo area provide impressive storage capacity for groceries, luggage, sports equipment, and everyday essentials. Folding rear seats further increase cargo flexibility, making the Prius surprisingly versatile for a compact vehicle.

Safety has always been a priority for Toyota, and the Prius is engineered with a strong safety structure and a variety of safety features designed to help protect occupants. Its predictable handling, excellent visibility, and reputation for reliability contribute to a confident driving experience.

Owners consistently praise the 2011 Prius for its outstanding fuel economy, low maintenance costs, comfortable ride quality, and exceptional longevity. Many Prius models are known for reaching high mileage while continuing to provide reliable service, making them among the most trusted vehicles in the automotive market.

The 2011 Toyota Prius Three is the ideal vehicle for someone looking for exceptional fuel efficiency, practical versatility, advanced hybrid technology, and proven Toyota reliability in one complete package. Economical, dependable, spacious, and built to last, this Prius Three is ready for its next owner and will continue delivering value, efficiency, and peace of mind for years to come.

Hand-finished leather upholstery, contrast stitching, and real wood trim elevate every detail. The curved BMW Interaction Display powered by iDrive 8.5, Bowers & Wilkins Sound System, and heated, ventilated, and massaging comfort seats create a refined atmosphere. The Range Rover Autobiography stands as a pinnacle of luxury, blending commanding road presence with a minimalist aesthetic. This flagship model emphasizes sophisticated craftsmanship and a dual-personality of serene highway cruising and legendary all-terrain capability, defining the upper echelons of the luxury SUV market by delivering a tailored experience.

The powertrain lineup delivers effortless acceleration and remarkable refinement, highlighted by a twin-turbocharged V8 engine featuring mild-hybrid technology to optimize efficiency and smooth out stop-start transitions. Power is managed via an automatic transmission sending drive to all four wheels. Standard all-wheel steering drastically reduces the turning circle, while the sophisticated electronic air suspension ensures the chassis remains flat and composed through corners without sacrificing a plush ride.

Embracing a clean design philosophy, the exterior showcases flush glazing and distinctive headlights that flow into a seamless body structure. At the rear, signature vertical taillights remain hidden until illuminated, framing a split-folding power tailgate. Inside, the cabin elevates luxury with extensive premium leather coverage stretching across almost every surface. The Autobiography features semi-aniline leather seating, bespoke carpet mats, and refined metal treadplates, creating a sanctuary-like environment.

The cockpit centers around a curved floating glass touchscreen running the latest version of the intuitive infotainment software. The center console has been streamlined by integrating climate and terrain controls directly into the screen sliders, creating a clutter-free visual landscape. A high-definition interactive driver display is complemented by a comprehensive head-up display, while entertainment is anchored by a premium signature surround sound system utilizing speakers integrated directly into the seat headrests.

Occupant protection and driver awareness are supported by a comprehensive suite of active safety technologies. Standard equipment includes automated emergency braking with pedestrian detection and lane keeping assist. The adaptive cruise control system receives significant upgrades, incorporating specialized assistance features that utilize navigation data to automatically adjust speed for upcoming road bends. Additionally, off-road cruise control handles low-speed adjustments over challenging terrain, allowing the driver to focus purely on steering.

Passenger wellness is paramount, featuring power-adjustable front and rear seats equipped with heating, cooling, and advanced massage functions. The multi-zone automatic climate control works alongside an advanced cabin air purification system that filters allergens. Rear passengers enjoy an elevated experience with powered window sunblinds, a glass panoramic roof that floods the cabin with natural light, and illuminated seatbelt buckles that ease fastening in low-light conditions.
